body:
SEBZO X SMP is a curated modpack designed to provide a stable and enhanced multiplayer survival experience. The pack includes performance optimizations, quality-of-life improvements, and lightweight content additions that expand gameplay without altering the core mechanics of Minecraft.

This modpack is intended for long-term SMP worlds and aims to maintain compatibility, stability, and ease of use for both players and server hosts. All included mods are sourced only from trusted platforms such as Modrinth and CurseForge, and each mod is used according to its official distribution permissions.

Key Features

Performance Enhancements: Improves client and server performance for smoother gameplay and reduced latency.

Quality-of-Life Additions: Minor but impactful improvements that streamline crafting, exploration, and building.

Balanced Content Expansion: Introduces new world features or mechanics while keeping the vanilla gameplay feel intact.

SMP-Friendly: Configured to reduce conflicts, maintain stable progression, and support multiplayer environments.

Actively Maintained: The modpack will receive updates to ensure compatibility and performance with future game versions.

Purpose

The goal of SEBZO X SMP is to offer a reliable and enjoyable experience for players who want an improved survival environment without overwhelming them with complex or intrusive modification
